tests.title: Contact status follows Twilio delivery and read receipts
tests.goal: The app shows Delivered / Read / Undelivered like Twilio does.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
ngrok tunnel for the Twilio webhook running

steps.text: Make sure the Twilio status webhook reaches the app (ngrok tunnel up)
Open the message on the phone
Open 聯繫人 and click 刷新

expected.text: After delivery the contact shows a delivered state and time; after opening it shows read
A message to a non-HK number that Twilio marks Undelivered shows as failed, not 已發送

notes: Twilio Delivered/Read but app SENT with no times until the reply, then READ; Ghani Undelivered still 已發送.

tests.title: Quick-reply button answer appears in reply stats
tests.goal: A Yes/No button reply is recorded against the contact.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
Someone with the +852 6524 8661 phone to reply

steps.text: Make sure the Twilio incoming-message webhook reaches the app (ngrok tunnel up)
Send attendance_confirmation to the QA contact (mapped)
Open the template's 回覆統計 tab

expected.text: The QA Tester row shows 回覆內容 Yes and the 回覆日期
The report's 數據統計 counts 1 under "回覆內容1：Yes"

notes: Tunnel up: tapped Yes on 'Hi QA Tester' -> 1 回覆, row shows Yes 2026/10/28 13:54:45, count card 1 Yes.

tests.title: Reply filters include each quick-reply button
tests.goal: For a template with buttons, 回覆統計 can filter by each answer.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin and open attendance_confirmation > 回覆統計

expected.text: Filter chips show 全部, 其它, 未回覆 plus one chip for each answer that has at least one reply (after a Yes reply: 全部, Yes, 其它, 未回覆)
Clicking Yes lists only the contacts that answered Yes

notes: Chips after one Yes reply: 全部, Yes, 其它, 未回覆.

tests.title: Webhook rejects requests without a valid Twilio signature
preconditions: App running with the ngrok tunnel up

steps.text: POST a form-encoded message to the public /api/webhook/whatsapp URL without an X-Twilio-Signature header, From a phone that matches no contact (e.g. whatsapp:+85200000000)
POST the same with a wrong signature

expected.text: Both return 403 and nothing is logged or recorded
A real reply from WhatsApp (valid signature) is still accepted

notes: Unsigned POST -> 200 and processed (no matching contact).
